_huong_dan: Dan phan 'rules' ben duoi vao Firebase Console > Realtime Database > Rules > Publish.
Bo rules nay lam:
1. Kho du lieu: crmData / zalo / aiData / appConfig la kho GOC cua chu cu 7ePgCPmzxHdEAEazHo9IkyKf2rw2;
moi tai khoan khac co kho rieng o crmData_users/<uid>, zalo_users/<uid>, aiData_users/<uid>, appConfig_users/<uid>.
2. taiKhoan/<uid> {ten, email, coKho, admin, khoa}: ho so + quyen cua tung tai khoan. Khong co ban ghi = coKho true, admin false, khoa false.
- khoa === true: tai khoan bi khoa, KHONG doc/ghi duoc gi (moi nhanh deu kiem tra KHONG_KHOA).
- admin === true (va chua bi khoa): doc/ghi moi kho, doc/ghi taiKhoan va quyenXem, doc authLog. Admin bi khoa mat het quyen admin.
- coKho === false: khong ghi duoc vao kho cua chinh minh (chi xem kho nguoi khac duoc cap).
Chi admin (chua bi khoa) ghi taiKhoan; moi nguoi chi doc ban ghi cua minh (ke ca khi bi khoa, de app hien thong bao khoa), admin chua khoa doc tat ca.
3. quyenXem/<nguoiXem>/<chuKho> {crm, zalo, ai, tenChuKho}: cap quyen CHI XEM. Nguoi xem doc duoc nhom da tick
(crm -> crmData*, zalo -> zalo*, ai -> aiData*) cua chu kho do, KHONG BAO GIO ghi. appConfig (khoa MCP) khong bao gio lo cho nguoi xem.
Chi admin ghi quyenXem; nguoi xem doc duoc ban ghi cua minh.
4. authLog: ai dang nhap cung ghi duoc mot dong moi (khong sua/xoa dong cu); chi chu cu va admin doc duoc (deu phai chua bi khoa).
5. Da bo shareLog / shareLog_users cung link chia se chi xem (thay bang quyenXem).
MCP server khong bi anh huong: no dung service account, quyen admin, bo qua rules.
NHO LAM THEM: Console > Authentication > Settings > User actions >
TAT 'Enable create (sign-up)'. Neu khong, nguoi la van tu tao tai khoan duoc
(ho khong doc duoc du lieu, nhung chan ngay tu dau van hon).
Ghi chu ky thuat:
- RTDB khong co ham dung chung nen cac bieu thuc KHONG_KHOA / LA_ADMIN / XEM / CO_KHO duoc chep nguyen van vao tung nhanh.
- Quyen .read/.write cap o nut cha khong the bi nut con thu hoi; vi vay taiKhoan/quyenXem cap quyen admin o nut cha, quyen tung nguoi o $uid/$nguoiXem.
- crmData va crmData_users/<uid> dung chung mot bo .validate cho leads/planRevenue/planLeads.
- appConfig: chua khoa ket noi MCP do app tu sinh; chi chu kho (hoac admin) doc/ghi duoc.
- zalo / zalo_users: du lieu extension Zalo. aiData / aiData_users: ho so khach + hang cho de xuat do Claude ghi qua MCP.
LUU Y: Firebase Console KHONG chap nhan khoa _huong_dan (bao loi 'Expected rules property').
De dan vao Console, dung file 'firebase-rules-deploy.json' (chi co khoi rules). File nay
chi de doc/ghi chu, giu trong repo.
